hooks.text: 穿越13个城市关卡，对抗四个荒诞敌人阵营，并使用从大锤、炸药到特殊机枪的武器库。
hooks.excerpt: Visit 13 levels on urban settings - Fight bunny-suit zombies, semi-naked waifus, punk gurls and others on 4 different enemy factions - Use a wide variety of weapons from sledgehammers to dynamite and even panty-drying miniguns
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 主角能在复古FPS冒险中解锁魔法少女变身，为枪战加入明确的形态变化。
hooks.excerpt: Discover the ability to transform into a Mahou Shoujo
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 沿着虚拟电脑中的异常路径深入，揭开Zanardi电脑里隐藏的秘密及其过去。
